Seventh development release of 0.18.0 and the last before 0.18.0: the release candidate. It completes the API schema; everything else is as in dev6.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.18.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.18.0 right.

Everything in [0.18.0-dev1](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev1) through [0.18.0-dev6](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev6) is included; read their notes for the full list.

### Fixed

- **The API schema describes the Oxidized configuration endpoints** for devices and virtual machines (nodes, current config, history, one version, diff and fetch now), so generated clients and the API browser include them.
